boundary_abel.conclusion: The target implies M_L(J)>1 on the selected boundary, including W_0=0

degree_transfer.zero_degree: wind(V_J)=0 implies no interior heat contact

exact.domain: L>=50, 0<tL<25 on prescribed first-order charts; the raised outer boundary also uses L>=B_epsilon

error_whitening.square: D_L maps the certified error box into (-1,1)^2
error_whitening.winding: The positive diagonal homotopy from I to D_L preserves nonvanishing and winding

nonpromotion.boundary_only: Boundary nonvanishing without a winding bound permits positive-index interior heat contacts
nonpromotion.radial: Box separation does not imply the stronger Euclidean radial threshold

exact.open_handoff: For every successor j and fixed epsilon, prove the normalized Abel gap on each nonempty hard bottom interval max(B_epsilon,sqrt((100+j)/50))<=L<=min(L_j,(c_*+epsilon)(100+j)/25), retaining W_0=0, the recurrent endpoint, q=1, equality boundaries, and adjacent-cutoff homotopies. Then prove the completely joined horizontal phase contribution H_j<3*pi/2. If the same Abel estimate extends to the full raised outer wedge, use the uniform-collar excision route instead.

radial_comparison.strictness: The radial condition is strictly stronger than M_L(J)>1

rectangular_rouche.conclusion: V_J and V_Z are boundary-nonzero and have equal winding

route_fork.boundary: Prove the Abel gap only on joined successor boundaries and H_j<3*pi/2; use C_j<pi/2 and the integer trap
route_fork.recommended_next: Attempt the one-dimensional hard-bottom Abel theorem first, preserving the full joined phase ledger
route_fork.uniform: Prove the Abel gap on the full two-dimensional raised outer wedge; excise it at zero degree

proof_boundary: This artifact proves the rectangular first-order boundary homotopy, error-whitening and winding invariance, adjacent-chart sub-box join, positive-index degree transfer, exact hard-bottom interval, and the two-route comparison. It does not prove the Xi Abel gap, horizontal phase bound, q<1 or bounded-L inner theorem, complete boundary nonvanishing, contact exclusion, Lambda<=0, PF-infinity, RH, or a Clay-prize conclusion.

rows.claim: Use the cutoff-local first-order main and its matched remainder.
rows.proof_boundary: This is local to one prescribed cutoff chart.

rows.claim: The C1 remainder gives a rectangular first-jet error set.
rows.proof_boundary: The two coordinates must not be merged before choosing a target.

rows.claim: The error-matched main gauge is the contact-box gauge.
rows.proof_boundary: Strict M_L>1 is required for a robust homotopy.

rows.claim: M_L(J)>1 transfers boundary nonvanishing and winding to Z.
rows.proof_boundary: This is a boundary theorem; it gives no interior noncontact.

rows.claim: The Euclidean radial margin implies but is not equivalent to the box margin.
rows.proof_boundary: Do not retain the stronger radial target by habit.

rows.claim: A positive diagonal map sends the error rectangle to the unit square.
rows.proof_boundary: The map changes phase parametrization but not degree.

rows.claim: Continuous positive diagonal whitening preserves winding.
rows.formula: D_(L,s)=(1-s)I+sD_L is invertible with positive determinant.
rows.proof_boundary: No metric lower bound follows from orientation preservation alone.

rows.claim: The normalized Abel gap implies M_L(J)>1 on any selected boundary arc.
rows.proof_boundary: The Xi-specific Abel inequality remains unproved.

rows.claim: The boundary Abel target remains division-free at W_0=0.
rows.proof_boundary: No quotient by W_0 or the first-jet norm is permitted.

rows.claim: The adjacent first-order chart jump occupies a strict sub-box.
rows.proof_boundary: These are overlap bounds, not a global fixed-cutoff theorem.

rows.claim: One box-separated chart joins its adjacent chart without zero.
rows.proof_boundary: Every prescribed equality boundary and overlap is still included.

rows.claim: The positive Xi normalizer and its derivative shear preserve degree.
rows.proof_boundary: The normalizer is not discarded from quantitative estimates.

rows.claim: Every real heat contact has strictly positive local index in (x,t).
rows.proof_boundary: The orientation convention must remain counterclockwise in (x,t).

rows.claim: Boundary transfer plus zero winding excludes all interior contacts.
rows.proof_boundary: The proxy may have interior zeros; only its boundary winding is used.

rows.claim: A sub-one proxy winding is enough on each oriented successor.
rows.proof_boundary: Boundary nonvanishing alone does not prove kappa_j<1.

rows.claim: Use the ray-aligned successor bottoms.
rows.proof_boundary: Finite base and shoulder ownership remain separate.

rows.claim: The low-c q>=1 Abel obligation on bottom j is one explicit L interval.
rows.proof_boundary: An empty interval contributes no hard bottom arc.

rows.claim: Oscillatory and dominant theorems close the rest of the raised outer bottom.
rows.formula: c_*+epsilon<t_jL<25 is oscillatory; t_jL>=25 is dominant.
rows.proof_boundary: q<1 and L<B_epsilon remain inner or finite-shoulder obligations.

rows.claim: A two-dimensional Abel gap gives complete outer-collar noncontact.
rows.proof_boundary: This stronger route removes the independent outer winding theorem.

rows.claim: A one-dimensional boundary Abel gap can be paired with the horizontal phase cap.
rows.formula: M_L>1 on joined boundary and H_j<3*pi/2, C_j<pi/2 => kappa_j<1.
rows.proof_boundary: This weaker-domain route retains an independent winding obligation.

rows.claim: Boundary nonvanishing without a winding bound does not exclude contact.
rows.formula: F=x^2-2t has a boundary-nonzero rectangle with one index +1 contact.
rows.proof_boundary: This is a generic heat guard, not an Xi counterexample.

rows.claim: Attack the error-matched boundary Abel theorem before a two-dimensional upgrade.
rows.formula: Prove the Abel gap on every nonempty hard bottom interval, then compose the joined horizontal flux below 3*pi/2.
rows.proof_boundary: No contact exclusion, Lambda<=0, PF-infinity, RH, or prize conclusion is proved.
